objective: G3 and G16: with two positive repeated middle names in the guarded two-route formula, locate the boundary between clause-like global coordination and a tractable regrouping by occurrences of each hidden pad.
status: Complete: Two repeated middle names or, separately, pairwise-only middle and pad identities can carry general 3-SAT. Disjoint paths with low pad occurrence and nested pairs admit linear decision; few exceptional names can be conditioned upon.
title: Two repeated middle variables and a second way to group the hidden choices
